## ВТБ \(Казахстан\) — Company.id 15486

```json
}
```

Frozen base commit: `fe29fbc1291b8842ed201261408a3bc690875b55`. Checked: `2026-10-03T12:48:20.724935Z`.

### Exact versions and source

- Current/base SVG: [base.svg](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/f27bccf13dfa4950b1b2f2063a5db93c2c6549fc/review-materials/15486/base.svg) — SHA-256 `5c96668e7bbc621cad4840cebc706467fda2a69b0aecd33b475a2136fe3e2a67`.

### Evidence and judgment

- official checked 2026-10-03T12:41:00Z: [https://vtb-bank.kz](https://vtb-bank.kz); asset [https://vtb-bank.kz/local/templates/vtb\_main/assets/images/icons/favicon.svg](https://vtb-bank.kz/local/templates/vtb_main/assets/images/icons/favicon.svg). Live homepage references favicon.svg and logo.svg; head shows the current slanted-bars flag as the site icon. (independence group: vtbkz-site).
- official checked 2026-10-03T12:41:00Z: [https://vtb-bank.kz/local/templates/vtb\_main/assets/images/icons/logo.svg](https://vtb-bank.kz/local/templates/vtb_main/assets/images/icons/logo.svg). Header logo is the same cyan flag plus #002882 ВТБ wordmark — same symbol variant as the favicon. (independence group: vtbkz-site).
- Independent evidence: Both observations come from the bank's own live site \(favicon and header logo, same fetch context\); identity anchored by record metadata..
- Identity: confirmed — vtb-bank.kz is the official site of АО «Банк ВТБ \(Казахстан\)» per record metadata \(ID/country/url\)..
- Currency: confirmed — Live site fetched 2026-10-03 serves the cyan flag as favicon and header logo..
- Variant: confirmed — Current variant is the bare flag of three slanted bars in #00AAFF; the base icon is the older circled badge with white bars on #009FDF — a supported presentation/color update, same underlying symbol..
- Uncertainty: Platform rendering beyond Desktop Compose was not exercised; Android/iOS checks are not-tested because no emulator/iOS tooling is available..

Rationale: The bank's own live site serves this exact flag \(favicon.svg\) and the same flag in its header logo.svg as the current brand symbol of VTB Kazakhstan; the base icon is the older circled badge variant with a superseded blue. Supported currency/presentation update from an original vector with receipt-bound provenance..
Role: standalone-symbol: the mark is used bare \(transparent background\) on the bank site; no enclosing circle in the current variant. Kept as the transparent mark without inventing a backing.; variant: bare three-slanted-bar flag in #00AAFF on transparent; replaces the older white-bars-on-#009FDF-circle badge.
Visible difference: Deliberate: the update replaces the older circled white-bars badge with the current bare cyan flag, exactly as the bank presents its symbol today. Within the source-versus-final comparison there is no unintended difference..
Details: Edges crisp at 240px; the three bars render with sharp corners, uniform #00AAFF fill, no artifacts from optimization on either theme.. Proportions: The flag's 20x13 aspect is preserved \(viewBox unchanged\); in the square catalog cell it letterboxes centered, which matches the source proportions without stretching..

Source-to-final transformations:
- SVGO 4.1.0 with the frozen repository svgo configuration: input 321 bytes -\> trial 270 bytes; path data unchanged at precision 4, fill #00AAFF serialized as #0af \(same color\), wrapper group and redundant attributes removed.
- Selected the optimized trial as final bytes \(sha256 f00d596d3f43f5b3011b14362be07be52d07f8ab4be37ba1d82a403012fc15e4\) after working-versus-optimized comparison with an independent rasterizer at 240px on white: visually identical; no other geometry, color or transparency change was made.

![Before and after — dark background](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/f27bccf13dfa4950b1b2f2063a5db93c2c6549fc/review-materials/15486/comparison-dark.png?raw=true)

### Render checks and limits

Desktop renderer recorded: `offscreen CPU Skia/painterResource` at `2026-10-03T12:47:03.095513017Z`. The change is the intended current-brand presentation update; the candidate is crisp and complete on both themes.

- android-compose: not-tested (available: false) — Android build tooling is present on this host, but no emulator system image or virtual device is installed; downloading images was outside this run, so this target was not tested..
- android-native: not-tested (available: false) — Same missing emulator prerequisites and no connected devices; this target was not tested..
- ios-compose: not-tested (available: false) — No iOS tooling available in this environment; not tested..

Desktop observation is for the generated XML through Compose Desktop `painterResource`, not a claim of successful Android/iOS or native-widget rendering. Unavailable targets remain untested; reviewer visual approval and merge remain separate decisions.
